resources.string: "Ifoto y’umwimerere ntiyashoboye kubikwa. Reba ububiko bw’igikoresho wongere ugerageze."

"Koresha uburenganzira bwawe bwa none bwo kwinjira ukoresheje isura yanditswe n’urufunguzo rw’igikoresho rw’umwimerere kugira ngo uvugurure uburenganzira bw’ibanga bwarangiye. Amahitamo yo kubyemera aracyatandukanye."
"Banza wemeze isura yawe mbere yo guhitamo amafoto yo kohereza."
"Tegereza igikorwa kiri gukorwa kirangire mbere yo guhitamo andi mafoto."
"Kohereza amafoto asigaye byahagaritswe. Amafoto yatangiye gutunganywa araguma mu bubiko bw’amafoto yawe."
"Amafoto yoherejwe kandi yatangiye gutunganywa araguma mu bubiko bw’amafoto yawe. Kohereza ibitararangira birahagarara."
"Kopi y’amakuru yawe yanditswe mu nyandiko wahisemo."
"Icyifuzo cyawe cyabitswe. Kuboneka kwabyo bigenwa n’uko seriveri ibyerekana."
"Ibi bisaba gusiba konti y’umushyitsi ukoresha ubu. Bisaba kubanza gusuzumwa. Ushobora kugenzura uko bihagaze hano mbere yo kwandikisha isura yawe."
"Kugura byahagaritswe. Iki gikorwa nta mafaranga cyakwishyuye."
"Google Play yavuye ku murongo. Ongera ugerageze igihe ibonetse."
"Nta gahunda y’ifatabuguzi yujuje ibisabwa iboneka muri Google Play."
"Hitamo gahunda. Google Play irakwereka amabwiriza yayo yose mbere y’uko wemeza."
"Nta fatabuguzi rya Google Play rikora ryabonetse kuri iyi konti ya Play."
"Injira muri konti wakoresheje ugura ibi, hanyuma ugarure ibyo waguze."
"Ubwishyu buracyategerejwe muri Google Play. Uburenganzira ku mafoto buzavugururwa nyuma y’uko ubwishyu bwemejwe."
"Ibi byaguzwe ni iby’indi konti ya Lovelies."
"Ibyaguzwe byo kugerageza byemejwe. Uburenganzira ku mafoto y’umwimerere muri serivisi nyakuri buracyafite imbibi."
"Ibyaguzwe byemejwe. Uburenganzira bwawe bwa none bwemejwe na seriveri."
"Usanzwe ufite iri fatabuguzi. Garura ibyo waguze kugira ngo rigenzurwe."
"Iri fatabuguzi ntiriboneka kuri konti yawe ya Play cyangwa mu karere kawe."
"Kugura muri Google Play ntibishoboka kuri iki gikoresho."
"Google Play ntiyashoboye kugerwaho. Reba uko uhagaze ku murongo wongere ugerageze."
"Google Play ntiyashoboye gusoza iki gikorwa. Ongera ugerageze cyangwa ugarure ibyo waguze."
" Garura ibyo waguze kugira ngo wongere ugerageze kubyemeza."
